newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Zeitler says no time pressure on EMU Stability Pact.
newsitem.headline: Zeitler says no time pressure on EMU Stability Pact.

text.p: Bundesbank council member Franz Christoph Zeitler said on Wednesday that there was no time pressure on agreement on a Stability Pact.
Asked by reporters if it was necessary to agree a Stability Pact for EMU at the Dublin summit in December Zeitler said : "There is no pressure of time."
Zeitler was speaking after addressing the 10th meeting of the European Finance Convention in Dublin.
He said he hoped progress would be made on the Stability Pact at the Dublin EU summit in December but said it was the reponsibility of government to make progress.

Zeitler said he was not sure if the present draft of the Stability Pact, provided by the European Commission, fully complied with the political will of EU finance ministers as expressed at their informal meeting in Dublin on September 5.
Finance ministers agreed at that meeting that the European Council would impose sanctions against any member state which failed to meet the reference values for their public finances.
This would be necessary to ensure the credibility of the new system, Zeitler said.
